Reference / error

error#

Common argument and state failures.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

confirm width > 0 else throw InvalidArgument.because("width must be positive");
catch InvalidArgument.because(reason) { report(reason); }

Description#

Common argument and state failures. Each carries a human-readable reason, and text() shows it: InvalidArgument.because("width must be positive").

Errors#

enum InvalidArgument#

enum InvalidArgument is Error = (because(reason is string))

An argument a call cannot take; reason says why.

because(reason is string)
